title: Public mobile real-device verification protocol
purpose: Define a repeatable iPhone/mobile smoke test for the public 怪文回文メーカー without changing generation quality rules or exposing research-only content.
automatic_diagnostics: current displayed reading is a strict palindrome

manual_smoke_test.action: Open diagnostic URL in portrait orientation.
manual_smoke_test.pass: 実機診断 panel appears; data=14/14; horizontal overflow=none.

manual_smoke_test.action: Tap 第一層/第二層/第三層 one by one.
manual_smoke_test.pass: Layer changes with one tap and result remains visible without accidental zoom.

manual_smoke_test.action: Tap 回文を1本つくる and 別の回文をつくる; then open 作り方を選ぶ and tap 逆語ペアで作る / 継ぎ目型で作る.
manual_smoke_test.pass: Each generation path refreshes the result and current diagnostic stays 回文.

manual_smoke_test.action: Move 怪文度 slider from minimum to maximum and back.
manual_smoke_test.pass: Slider is operable by touch; result refreshes; no page horizontal scroll.

manual_smoke_test.action: In step 3, tap 今の回文を長くする when enabled, or 長文化を開始; then tap 1段伸ばす at least three times.
manual_smoke_test.pass: Stage label/history update; disabled state is understandable when no direct growth family exists; touch controls remain usable.

manual_smoke_test.action: Use 文レベル長文化 once, then 1段ほどく.
manual_smoke_test.pass: Wrapped result is a strict palindrome and returns to prior state.

manual_smoke_test.action: Tap 10本比較, then select an item near the bottom of the list.
manual_smoke_test.pass: List item opens reliably and no sticky/overlay element blocks taps.
No persistent horizontal overflow; diagnostic viewport values update.

manual_smoke_test.action: Use pinch zoom once, then return to normal scale.
manual_smoke_test.pass: Text remains readable and visual viewport diagnostic changes without breaking layout.

manual_smoke_test.action: Tap 診断結果をコピー.
manual_smoke_test.pass: Clipboard copy succeeds, or fallback copy dialog appears.

out_of_scope: Preserving the currently generated sentence across a full page reload

reporting.preferred: Paste copied diagnostic text plus the IDs of any failed manual checks.
reporting.minimum: Device/browser, portrait or landscape, and failed check ID.

safety_invariants: Diagnostic mode must not alter candidate generation probabilities.
Diagnostic mode must not inject historical research candidates into the public pool.
Normal URL must not display the diagnostic panel.
Mobile layout changes must not change corpus/generator data.
